cards.intuition: Local rotations prevent a sorted insertion sequence from turning the tree into a chain. Order remains available for boundaries and traversal.
cards.formula: lookup, insert, delete, predecessor, successor = O(log n)
cards.topic: Balanced Search Trees vs Hash Indexes: Range vs Point Lookups

cards.intuition: Hashing is the fast exact-address book; a tree is the ordered directory. Pay logarithmic navigation when ranges and neighbors matter.
cards.formula: hash point lookup expected O(1); tree range O(log n + k)
cards.topic: Balanced Search Trees vs Hash Indexes: Range vs Point Lookups

cards.intuition: Byte order, collation, and normalization decide where a key belongs. Writers and readers using different rules can lose present keys.
cards.formula: persist comparator and normalization version with ordered index
cards.topic: Balanced Search Trees vs Hash Indexes: Range vs Point Lookups

cards.intuition: A page fetch is expensive while comparisons inside the page are cheap. Packing hundreds of separators into one node gains hundreds of possible directions per read.
cards.topic: B-tree Intuition: Wide Nodes for Block Storage

cards.intuition: When a page overflows, divide it into two and promote a routing separator. Splits can propagate to a new root while all leaves remain equally deep.
cards.formula: full node → split nodes + parent separator
cards.topic: B-tree Intuition: Wide Nodes for Block Storage

cards.intuition: Internal pages route; linked leaves hold records. Descend once to the lower bound, then stream neighboring leaf pages.
cards.formula: range = tree descent + sequential leaf traversal
cards.topic: B-tree Intuition: Wide Nodes for Block Storage

cards.intuition: A B-tree orders complete keys. An inverted index changes the grain by mapping each contained term to all matching documents.
cards.formula: choose index key grain to match the predicate
cards.topic: B-tree Intuition: Wide Nodes for Block Storage

cards.intuition: Each edge consumes a symbol, so reaching a prefix costs its length rather than the dictionary size. Enumerate completions below that state.
cards.formula: lookup O(L); prefix output roughly O(L + k)
cards.topic: Tries and FSTs for Prefix Lookup and Autocomplete

cards.intuition: Collapse stretches with no branching into one labeled edge. The same prefix choices remain without paying for one heap object per character.
cards.formula: nonbranching symbol chain → one multi-symbol edge
cards.topic: Tries and FSTs for Prefix Lookup and Autocomplete

cards.intuition: A minimized automaton shares equivalent suffix states; a transducer also emits term IDs, offsets, or weights while consuming the key.
cards.formula: FST = deterministic state transitions + accumulated outputs
cards.topic: Tries and FSTs for Prefix Lookup and Autocomplete

cards.intuition: A trie adds one new path locally. A minimal FST gains compactness from global sharing, so updates usually arrive through overlays or rebuilt segments.
cards.formula: mutable prefix writes: trie; compact read-heavy dictionary: FST
cards.topic: Tries and FSTs for Prefix Lookup and Autocomplete
